column2: The units made a ten, so I carry one to the tens rod. But the tens rod is already full! There is no room for the extra ten. I am stuck.
It carries again, onto the hundreds! One carry can wake up the next one. Thank you!
I added on the tens rod, and now it has more than nine tens on it. But the tens rod cannot hold that many! Where does the extra ten go?
The hundreds rod! The ten jumps left onto the hundreds. Thank you, I nearly left it behind!
I want to add, but there aren't enough little beads left on this rod! Hmm... I'm stuck.
Slide five down, then take the small friend off! That makes it. Thank you!
There's no room on this rod for that many beads! Where do they all go? I'm stuck.
Add ten next door, then take the big friend away! Now it fits. Thank you!
I need to take some away, but there aren't enough beads on this rod to take! I'm stuck.
Take ten from next door, then add the big friend back! There it is. Thank you so much.
Times? Easy — I'll just add the two numbers together!
Ohhh — groups, not plus! Count them up, one at a time. Thank you, that is so much more!
